name: Harry Martinson
contribution: A Swedish writer, poet and former sailor.
legacy: He has been called "the great reformer of 20th-century Swedish poetry, the most original of the writers called 'proletarian'."

born_in: United Kingdoms of Sweden and Norway

checks.lead: Harry Martinson (6 May 1904 – 11 February 1978) was a Swedish writer, poet and former sailor. In 1949 he was elected into the Swedish Academy. He was awarded a joint Nobel Prize in Literature in 1974 together with fellow Swede Eyvind Johnson "for writings that catch the dewdrop and reflect the cosmos". The choice was controversial, as both Martinson and Johnson were members of the academy.
